# Annotation schemas for CMC and social media genres: resources from the TEI special interest group on CMC. 05 Dec 2015  1 min read  Cmc-Tei. Wiki pages of the special interest group Website of the Text Encoding Initiative. The special interest group “computer-mediated communication” of the Text Encoding Initiative (TEI) provides schemas for the annotation of cmc and social media genres which are conformant with the TEI standards for text encoding and which have been tested in corpus projects on French and German CMC. The schemas have been presented and discussed as part of the 2015 cmc-corpora conference in Rennes, France. ##### Cite.

Annotating Abstract Pronominal Anaphora in the DAD Project. How far are we from (semi-) automatic annotation of anaphoric links in corpora? A cognitive calculative approach towards discourse anaphora. Building a tool for annotating reference in discourse. Discourse annotation tasks have been enjoying particular interest in corpus linguistics in the last five-ten years. Given the general complexity of discourse concepts -and coreference is not an exception, no uniform annotation standard for coreference exists to date, and very few coreferentially annotated corpora are available. The current research is based on the RST Discourse Treebank, which we annotated with anaphoric links. Construction of a referentially annotated corpus and of necessary software for its exploitation can be useful both for general understanding of pronominal reference in discourse and for certain NLP tasks, such as anaphor resolution or generation. results.title: Towards Generating Automatic Anaphora Annotations
results.content: Training models that can perform well on various NLP tasks require large amounts of data, and this becomes more apparent with nuanced tasks such as anaphora and conference resolution. To combat the prohibitive costs of creating manual gold annotated data, this paper explores two methods to automatically create datasets with coreferential annotations; direct conversion from existing datasets, and parsing using multilingual models capable of handling new and unseen languages. The paper details the current progress on those two fronts, as well as the challenges the efforts currently face, and our approach to overcoming these challenges. Anaphora resolution and coreference resolution are Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks that involve identifying expressions that refer to the same entity Aloraini et al. (2021), while coreference resolution is the task of resolving mentions that refer to the same entity into clusters Aloraini et al. (2021); Abolohom and Omar (2015); Lata et al. The availability of annotated corpora with coreferential links is vital for anaphora resolution systems Abolohom and Omar (2017).
